newsitem.title: USA: Pioneer Railcorp carloadings up in January.
newsitem.headline: Pioneer Railcorp carloadings up in January.

text.p: Pioneer Railcorp said Wednesday its carloadings shipped in January rose to 2,983 from 2,071 a year ago, thanks in part to acquisitions of short lines in the last 12 months.
The company said the purchase of such short lines as Keokuk Junction, Rochelle, Michigan Southern and Shawnee Terminal railroads accounted for about half of the carloads shipped in January.
Carloadings are one of the factors used in determining Pioneer's gross revenues, the company said.
Pioneer Railcorp operates 15 freight short line railroads with more than 500 miles of track.
Its shares were trading down 1/4 Wednesday at 1-7/8.
